summary: Mexco Energy Corporation filed an 8-K to report its fiscal 2026 financial results and provide a property development update. The filing discloses net income of $1.31M ($0.64/diluted share), a 24% decrease from fiscal 2025 on revenues of $6.56M (-8%). The company participated in 58 wells (57 horizontal, one vertical) at a cost of ~$1.25M, with 20 wells expected to complete this fiscal year; also 177 gross royalty wells (.07 net) were drilled by others. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure and operational update, not a special situation like M&A, activism, or restructuring. No deal terms are present as the filing does not involve a transaction.
